summary: Frontend-only regression at 390x844 for GSP Beograd fuel-log app with new per-tab AdminGate (login screen removed; only Vozila & Izveštaj require 'puzopb'). All 13 critical flows PASS: (1) App opens directly on Smena with no login screen – arrival-form, arrival-bus-input, pump-chip-N, arrival-qty-input, arrival-note-input, arrival-save-button and arrived-count all accessible without auth; (2) full arrival save works unauthenticated (7000, pump 3, 23,45 L -> arrived-count 1, recent-7000 rendered); (3) locked admin-badge on Smena navigates to Izveštaj which shows admin-gate with login-password-input; (4) wrong password shows login-error 'Pogrešna lozinka'; (5) 'puzopb' unlocks Izveštaj (report-arrivals + logout-button visible); (6) report-arrival-7000 row order verified = garage number FIRST (idx 0), then time '11:10' (idx 5), then 'Pumpa 3 · 23,45 L' (idx 11); (7) tab-vozila when unlocked shows vozila-search-input (admin-gate hidden); (8) logout-button in Izveštaj re-locks both admin tabs (admin-gate re-appears on Izveštaj and Vozila) while Smena remains fully usable and arrival data preserved; (9) when unlocked, admin-badge on Smena opens admin-sheet with admin-logout-button (and admin-close-button); (10) day-excel-button triggers a .xlsx download on web ('Tocenje_10.10.2026.xlsx'); (11) day-pdf-button executes without crashing the app; (12) week-pdf-button and week-share-button execute without crashing; (13) After reload, data persists (arrived-count 1, arrival visible in Izveštaj with Pumpa 2 · 12,00 L) and admin session persists (Izveštaj renders content directly, no gate). No red-screen errors, no console errors from app code, UI entirely in Latin script. No deprecated Expo packages (uses expo-print, expo-file-system, expo-haptics, expo-image, expo-router).
critical_code_review_comments: admin-gate.tsx is clean and well-scoped; renders children only when unlocked, otherwise shows gate. Keeps Smena fully public which matches requirement.
index.tsx admin-badge correctly routes to /izvestaj when locked and opens admin-sheet when unlocked; good UX.

izvestaj.tsx: 'Stigli - redom po vremenu' row renders bus first (arrBus w=56), then time (arrTime w=56), then pump info – matches spec; sorted by time ascending via localeCompare which is correct for HH:mm.
xlsx-template.ts and reports.ts: exportDayExcel triggers a Blob download on web (confirmed via Playwright page.expect_download, filename 'Tocenje_<date>.xlsx'). No crashes.

Minor: logout flow does not clear the active tab, so reload after logout from Izveštaj lands back on Izveštaj (admin-gate). This is correct behavior but a small UX improvement would be redirecting to Smena after logout; not required.
All files remain well under 700 lines, env usage correct, no HTML elements, all text wrapped in <Text>, testIDs present on every interactive element.
seed_data_creation: Fresh storage via localStorage.clear() before each run. One arrival created per flow (7000 or 7013) for export/report verification; cleaned by storage clear in subsequent runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password 'puzopb' (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Smena (tab-index) has NO login - open to all users. Only Vozila (tab-vozila) and Izveštaj (tab-izvestaj) show admin-gate when locked. admin-gate testIDs: admin-gate, login-password-input, login-submit-button, login-error. Smena admin-badge: when LOCKED -> router.navigate('/izvestaj') to gate; when UNLOCKED -> opens admin-sheet with admin-logout-button, admin-close-button. Izveštaj has logout-button that locks admin tabs (Smena stays). Izveštaj arrival row order verified: bus number, time (HH:mm), 'Pumpa N · qty L'. Excel export works on web via Blob download (filename pattern 'Tocenje_<date>.xlsx'); PDF/share endpoints execute without crash. Session+data persist via AsyncStorage/localStorage across reload. Valid bus numbers include 7000, 7013, 7014, 2588, 8114. Viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all 13 critical flows pass; no bugs or regressions found.
